title: Manipulation / Carry Capacity Envelope — Micro to Macro and Space
correction: payload capacity is not one scalar 'N kg'. It is configuration-, gravity-, acceleration-, geometry- and interface-dependent.
manipulator_equation: tau = M(q) qdd + C(q,qd) + g(q,g_env) + J(q)^T F_ext
feasibility: payload/manipulation operation is allowed only where every joint torque, structural stress, stability/anchoring, actuator thermal, contact, collision and control constraint remains inside its envelope
space_effects: lower gravity reduces weight but not inertial mass
microgravity makes acceleration/reaction forces and momentum management dominant
lunar low gravity also reduces available traction/normal force, so anchoring can become more limiting than lifting
asteroid/very-low-g operations require capture/anchoring/containment to prevent both tool and resource from drifting
charged dust and electrostatic/magnetic state can alter handling and separation

carry_classes.name: in-situ anchored manipulation
carry_classes.scope: resource boulders, large truss/road/pad segments, Luke/Mark/infrastructure modules

carry_classes.name: free-space manipulation
carry_classes.scope: orbital assembly/repair where momentum exchange and anchoring replace gravity-load limits
